summary: This study investigates the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of tungsten on cobalt nanoparticles to prevent oxidation and improve the properties of WC–Co hardmetals. The ALD process uses WF6 and Si2H6 as precursors, and the growth rate is 3.9 Å per AB cycle. The study also examines the formation of oxide layers (CoO and WO3) and their impact on the ALD process.
